message: Hello, can you help me with something?
Of course! What do you need assistance with?
I'm having trouble with my code. It's not working as expected.
I'd be happy to help. Can you provide more details about the issue?
Sure. Here's the error message I'm getting: 'TypeError: Cannot read property 'x' of undefined'.
This error typically occurs when you're trying to access a property of an undefined or null value. Can you share the relevant code snippet?
I see the issue. You're trying to access the 'x' property of 'obj', but it doesn't exist. You should use 'obj.y' instead. 'x' is undefined in this case.
Ah, I see my mistake now. Thank you for pointing it out!
You're welcome! If you have any more questions, feel free to ask.
